messages.content: 去年現代藝術博物館的會員們有多頻繁地參觀？

function.name: most_frequent_visitor
function.description: Retrieve the visitor who visited the museum the most within a given period. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

start_date.description: The start date of the period, format: yyyy-mm-dd.

end_date.description: The end date of the period, format: yyyy-mm-dd.

minimum_visits.description: The minimum number of visits to qualify. Default: 1

message.reasoning: The user asks: "去年現代藝術博物館的會員們有多頻繁地參觀？" Means: "How frequently did members of the Museum of Contemporary Art visit last year?" They want the most frequent visitor? Actually the question: "去年現代藝術博物館的會員們有多頻繁地參觀？" Could be interpreted as: "How often did members of the Museum of Contemporary Art visit last year?" They might want the average visits per member or the most frequent visitor. The function is "most_frequent_visitor" which returns the visitor who visited the most within a period. The question: "去年現代藝術博物館的會員們有多頻繁地參觀？" Could be answered by retrieving the most frequent visitor. But the question is about members, not a single visitor. But we can interpret as: "What is the most frequent visitor among members last year?" The function requires museum_name, start_date, end_date. We need to provide those. The museum name: "現代藝術博物館" (Museum of Contemporary Art). The period: last year. If today is 2026-10-16, last year would be 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31. So we call the function with museum_name: "現代藝術博物館", start_date: "2025-01-01", end_date: "2025-12-31". Minimum_visits default 1. So we call the function.
